artBrief: **Science-fiction travel.** A compact starship with a book-shaped sail passes colorful planets. Travel patches are abstract shapes, not flags or passport text.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Science-fiction travel. A compact starship with a book-shaped sail passes colorful planets. Travel patches are abstract shapes, not flags or passport text. A compact little starship with one large open-book-shaped ivory sail passing two bold colorful planets. Deep space blues with coral and gold, dynamic but simple silhouette.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
